objective: Replace secret-looking fixture values in the leftover-cleanup tests so secret scanners stop flagging them, keeping every assertion's meaning.
scope: GitGuardian flagged a 'Generic CLI Secret' for fixtures such as `--token S3CRET1`, `TOKEN=S3CRET2`, `env: { TOKEN: "S3CRET3" }` and `--token x`. Replace each with values that keep the test's purpose (the printed output must not contain the hidden value) but do not look like credentials: use a neutral option and variable name (for example `--label hidden-value-one`, `LABEL=hidden-value-two`, `env: { LABEL: "hidden-value-three" }`) and update the matching assertions. Search the whole file with the plugin rg for token, secret, S3CRET, password and key=value credential shapes and change every fixture hit.
constraints: Change only fixture strings and their assertions in that file; keep the tests' intent and count.
Make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
When done and checked, stop and report.

criteria.text: No credential-shaped fixture remains in the file, every test keeps its purpose, and mise run verify passes
